title: Customized TULSA-PRO Ablation Registry
summary: This patient registry will capture data from patients who have been or who are undergoing the transurethral ultrasound ablation (TULSA) procedure as part of their routine clinical care. The registry will shed light on real-world outcomes of safety and efficacy of the procedure and understand how a patient's quality of life is affected throughout their follow-up and lifetime.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

1. Male
2. \>18 years old
3. Candidate for TULSA-PRO treatment
4. willing and able to sign the Informed Consent form

Exclusion Criteria:

None.

University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center
